```{python}
#| label: fig-digital-flow-slack
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Worst setup slack of `bs_reg` at 250 MHz in the typical corner after each stage of the LibreLane run, from its STA steps. The synthesized netlist misses the clock because its high-fanout nets are not buffered. Placement adds the estimated wires. Buffering, clock tree synthesis with the propagated clock, and the timing repair raise the slack. The global routes and, after routing, the extracted wires take some of it back."
#| fig-alt: "Line chart with six flow stages on the horizontal axis and setup slack in nanoseconds on the vertical axis, with a dashed line at zero. The slack is -1.68 ns after synthesis, -2.33 ns after global placement, +0.97 ns after buffering and clock tree synthesis, +1.45 ns after timing repair, +1.34 ns after global routing and +1.08 ns at signoff with extracted parasitics."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

stages = ['synthesis', 'global\nplacement', 'buffering,\nclock tree', 'timing\nrepair',
          'global\nrouting', 'signoff\n(extracted)']
slack = [-1.6849, -2.3268, 0.9725, 1.4516, 1.3394, 1.0751]   # ns, typical

plt.rcParams.update({'font.size': 10})
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5, 3.2))
ax.axhline(0, color='#666666', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
ax.plot(range(len(stages)), slack, '-o', color='#08306b', linewidth=2, markersize=6)
for k, v in enumerate(slack):
    ax.annotate(f'{v:+.2f}'.replace('-', '\u2212'), (k, v), xytext=(0, 8 if v >= 0 else -16),
                textcoords='offset points', ha='center', color='#333333')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(stages)))
ax.set_xticklabels(stages)
ax.set_xlim(-0.4, 5.4)
ax.set_ylim(-3, 2.2)
ax.set_ylabel('worst setup slack (ns)')
ax.grid(axis='y', color='#e5e5e5', linewidth=0.8)
ax.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
